Resume                                                                                                                                  Agrani Vishwakarma 

1 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Career Objectives 

To secure an exciting and challenging role in a dynamic organization where I can leverage my expertise 

in document production, technical skills, and organizational abilities to contribute to business success 

while continuously enhancing my professional growth. 

Professional Summary 

Detail-oriented Senior Document Specialist with 5+ years of experience in document production, 

backend operations, and data processing across legal, IT, and telecom domains. Worked with Clifford 

Chance, specializing in advanced document formatting, editing, template management, and quality 

assurance for complex legal and business documents. Proven ability to manage high-volume workloads 

while maintaining accuracy, consistency, and strict turnaround timelines. Experienced in backend 

operations, Chat Process through roles at Tech Mahindra and Wipro. Well versed in MS Word, 

document lifecycle management, data accuracy, combined with attention to detail and client 

communication abilities. 

Work Experience 

 Senior Document Production Specialist at Clifford Chance, Gurugram (June 2022 – 

December 2025) 

 Create, edit, format, and convert legal and business documents using advanced MS Word. 

 Perform document comparison, merging, and proofreading to ensure accuracy. 

 Develop and maintain document templates and formatting standards. 

 Conduct quality checks (QA) before delivery to ensure compliance with client 

requirements. 

 Handle high-volume document requests within strict deadlines. 

 Collaborate with internal teams to improve workflow efficiency and turnaround time. 

 Provide client support for document-related queries and revisions. 

 Associate at Tech Mahindra Pvt Ltd, Pune (Oct 2020 – May 2021) 

 Processed and validated customer and account data within SLA timelines. 

 Ensured data accuracy, integrity, and compliance with company policies. 

 Performed data verification, correction, and report generation. 

 Conducted research to complete missing or incorrect data entries. 

 Supported backend operations and maintained documentation records. 

 Associate at Wipro Pvt Ltd, Pune (Dec 2018 – July 2019) 

 Provided backend support for telecom services (Broadband & PSTN). 

 Resolved service issues and ensured smooth process handling. 

Agrani Vishwakarma 

Contact No: +91 7498414429 

E-mail ID: agranivishwakarma1993@gmail.com 

mailto:agranivishwakarma1993@gmail.com


Resume                                                                                                                                                          Agrani Vishwakarma 

2 

 

 Managed service transfer requests and documentation updates. 

 Used tools like SAP, Citrix, Siebel, and PEGA for workflow processing. 

 Maintained accurate records and ensured system update. 

Educational Accomplishments: 

 Master of Technology (M.Tech) 

Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Bhopal — 2018 

 Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech) 

Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Bhopal — 2015 

 Diploma in Engineering 

Rajiv Gandhi Proudyogiki Vishwavidyalaya, Bhopal — 2012 

 

Technical Skills 

 MS Office: Advanced MS Word, Basic Excel & PowerPoint 

 Document Tools: Formatting, Templates, Track Changes 

 Tools Overview: Citrix, Siebel, PEGA, MAXIM, WAS, ONDB, FLEXCAB, MICA 

Working Skills 

 Document Production & Formatting, Data Entry, Validation, Quality Check 

 Backend Operations & Data Processing 

 Document Conversion & Editing, Attention to Detail & Accuracy 

 Template Creation & Standardization 

 Workflow Coordination & Process Optimization 

 Microsoft Word (Advanced), Excel (Basic), PowerPoint 

 Client Communication & Stakeholder Management, Time Management & Deadline 

Handling 

Personal Details 

 Date of Birth: 06th February 1994 

 Marital Status: Married 

 Nationality: Indian 

 Permanent Address: Runwaly Mycity Phase 2, Dombivli, Thane (Maharashtra) 

 

Declaration 

I hereby declare that the details provided above are accurate to the best of my knowledge. 

 

Date: __/__/2026                       Agrani Vishwakarma 

Place: Thane, India
